name: Amulet of the Devout, +3

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Channel Divinity
powers.text: Once per dawn, regain one use of Channel Divinity.

summary: +3 to your Cleric and Paladin spell attacks and save DC; once a day, a use of Channel Divinity back.
text: This amulet bears the symbol of a deity inlaid with precious stones or metals. While you wear the holy symbol, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Cleric and Paladin spells. While you wear this amulet, you can use your Channel Divinity feature without expending one of the feature's uses. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
